section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), a 13-item instrument used to measure body appreciation in the current study. Participants rated statements on a 5-point scale, with higher scores indicating greater body appreciation. The text reports internal consistency (α=.93) for the current sample and references mean BAS scores from other studies (Avalos et al., 2005; Bush et al., 2014), but does not provide specific demographic or correlational data for the current study.
